definitions.supplemental: Cf. somer dryeth mareis and mores . . . and maketh hem rou&yogh;e and harde and clynkery. v. N. E. D. clinkery.
definitions.meaning: Shrivelled with heat or cold, rough

source_text: clincig; adj. Shrivelled with heat or cold, rough:--Clincig síþfæt asperum iter, Hy. S. 104, 35. [Cf. somer dryeth mareis and mores . . . and maketh hem rou&yogh;e and harde and clynkery. v. N. E. D. clinkery.] Cf. clingan.
